sources.snippet: cross-encoder/ms-marco-TinyBERT-L-2-v2 is a pre-trained language model available on the Hugging Face Hub. It's specifically designed for the text-classification task in the transformers library.

sources.title: cross-encoder/ms-marco-TinyBERT-L2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Cross-Encoder for MS Marco This model was trained on the MS Marco Passage Ranking task. The model can be used for Information Retrieval: Given a query, encode the query will all possible passages (e.g. retrieved with ElasticSearch). Then sort the passages in a decreasing order. See SBERT.net Retrieve & Re-rank for more details. The training code is available here: SBERT.net Training MS Marco ...
